LanguageData.FIO_LetterTextReformIdeo:
You have enough development points to reform {0}!

Fluid Ideology Overhaul permits one deliberate mechanical ideology object in this reform. You may add or remove one meme, change the structure, change one precept, or edit one ritual or role. Multiple mechanical fields belonging to that same ritual or role may be edited together.

Names, descriptions, colours, icons, style categories and other presentation-only changes are free while this earned reform is open. Automatic consequences required by the selected meme do not count as additional deliberate changes and will be shown separately.

Before development points are spent, you will receive a review of the primary change and its consequences. You may return to editing or reset all changes without spending the reform.

To begin, open this ideoligion in the Ideoligions tab.
